findings.finding: Annual domain cash invoice is amortised when testing the monthly cash ceiling
findings.evidence: Grow79 Virginia annual invoice month is (20.67090995-1.25+15+79)*0.8*1.2=108.884073552 GBP; amortised row says95.68 and within100=true.

findings.finding: Event intent references enclosing manifest hash and canonical digest exclusions are undefined
findings.evidence: Manifest digest covers chunk content including intent that requires same manifest digest, creating a cycle; own digest fields also require explicit projections.

findings.finding: Delivery status is mutable inside an immutable sealed event intent
findings.evidence: Updating status/attempt_count/last_attempt_at changes serialized event intent hash and hence sealed chunk/root.

findings.finding: First daily acquisition starts at its own frozen information deadline
findings.evidence: Close21:00, collect22:00, positive1s latency yields known_at22:00:01 after close+60m cutoff; retry23:00 also late.

findings.finding: Earnings release features become known after their selected prior-close prediction origin/cutoff
findings.evidence: Tuesday08:00 public release cannot enter Monday closing predictor with earlier close+60m cutoff; same for late after-close releases. Distinguish pre/postrelease prediction from descriptive event study.
